name: image-marks
title: Image marks: Ada shows and marks the image the student sent
description: The chat's image marks on real providers: a typed message carrying her DFA page as an image, then asks in words to mark it. The director sends it to the thinker as mark_image, the thinker sees the image numbered (Set-of-Mark), its marks in words go through the Pointer on that image, and Ada shows it (image.show) then marks it (image.mark). Real tokens only: the fake thinker scripts no brief for these words.

turns.student: Here's a photo of my DFA for strings that start with 010.
Circle the state on my image that should be accepting.
Now underline the arrow out of q2 in my screenshot.
